source.book: An Intimate Note to the Sincere Seeker — Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

slides.text: Why does uncertainty feel so unbearable?
Because you've placed your certainty in the wrong place.
The world was never meant to be certain. It's *always* changing.
What doesn't change is the one who's watching it change. You.
Rely on that, and the world's uncertainty stops being a threat.
Being certain that everything is uncertain? That's actually *freedom*.
So stop bracing for a stability that was never there
slides.cta: Let the ground move. You don't have to.
